atoms.sound: Pictograms are a way to record information. They usually look something like this.

atoms.text: A pictogram has a title. Below the title, each line represents one category. The number of pictures next to it show its amount.
atoms.sound: A pictogram has a title. Below the title, each line represents one category. The number of pictures next to it show its amount.

atoms.text: In this example, the title is What is your favourite Italian lunch?, and the options are pizza and pasta. The number of pictures of pizza shows how many people voted for pizza as their favourite Italian lunch. The number of pastas shows how many people voted for pasta.
